title: The Christian Broker’s Tale: The Young Man with the Severed Hand and the Girl

paragraphs.en: I came as a stranger to your country, bringing merchandise, and stayed for many years. Born in Cairo, I followed my father's footsteps as a broker. One day, in the market of fodder merchants, a handsome young man on a tall ass approached me.
paragraphs.zh: 我作为一名陌生人来到你们的国家，带着货物经商，一待就是好几年。我出生在开罗，追随父亲的脚步成为一名经纪商。有一天，在饲料商人的市场里，一个英俊的年轻人骑着高大的驴子走近了我。

paragraphs.en: He asked about the worth of sesame.
paragraphs.zh: 他问起了芝麻的价值。

paragraphs.en: The next night, Shahrazad continued:
paragraphs.zh: 第二天晚上，沙海拉扎德接着说：

paragraphs.en: I heard that the Christian broker told the king of China: "It is worth a hundred dirhams," I replied. The young man instructed me to bring a measurer and porters to the al-Jawli Caravansary. After securing one hundred dirhams per measure from sesame merchants, confectioners, and fodder dealers, I went with four teams of porters to the caravansary.
paragraphs.zh: 我听基督教经纪人对中国的国王说：“这值一百第纳尔。”我说。年轻人吩咐我去jawli骆驼市场找量尺和搬运工。在与芝麻商、糖果商和饲料商协商后，每量获得了一百第纳尔的报酬，于是我带着四队搬运工去了骆驼市场。

paragraphs.en: There, the young man awaited us.
paragraphs.zh: 在那里，那个年轻人正等着我们。

paragraphs.en: He led me to the storeroom, instructing the measurer to enter while the porters loaded donkeys. After five thousand dirhams worth of sesame was sold, he offered ten dirhams per measure for my brokerage and kept four thousand and five hundred dirhams with him. He promised to return when his crop was sold out.
paragraphs.zh: 他领我来到仓库，吩咐量器手进去测量货物，而搬运工人们则忙着往驴车上装载芝麻。当价值五千迪拉姆的芝麻售出后，他给我提供了每斗十迪拉姆的佣金，并且自己留下了四千五百迪拉姆。他承诺等他的作物全部卖完后再回来结算。

paragraphs.en: I departed, surprised by his generosity.
paragraphs.zh: 我离开了，被他的慷慨惊到了。

paragraphs.en: For a month, I waited for him, and when he finally arrived, he asked about the money. I invited him in but he refused, saying he would return later. He left on an ass, while I went to fetch the money and waited again.
paragraphs.zh: 一个月里，我一直在等待他。终于有一天，他来了，一开口就问起钱的事。我请他进屋，但他婉拒了，说一会儿还会再来的。他骑着一头驴离开了，而我则去取钱，并再次耐心等待。

paragraphs.en: A month passed, and still no sign of him. I thought, "This is a generous young man; he has left his money with me for two months without claiming it." Finally, he returned, dressed in fine clothes, as if just from bathing.
paragraphs.zh: 一个月过去了，仍不见他的踪影。我想：“这人真是个大方的年轻人；他把钱交给我两个月了还没来要。”终于，他回来了，穿着一身华贵的衣裳，仿佛刚沐浴完毕一般。

paragraphs.en: Morning came, and Shahrazad fell silent. Dinarzad said, "What an intriguing tale!" Shahrazad replied, "Wait until tomorrow night to hear more."
paragraphs.zh: 晨光初现，沙赫札德停下了讲述。丁纳扎德说道：“这故事真引人入胜！”沙赫札德回答道：“等到明天晚上你才能听到更多。”

paragraphs.en: The next night, Shahrazad continued:
paragraphs.zh: 第二天晚上，沙海拉扎德接着说：

paragraphs.en: I heard that the Christian broker told the king of China about a young man who seemed fresh from bathing. When I saw him, I asked if he wanted his money back. He said to wait until after selling his crop, promising to come the following week.
paragraphs.zh: 我听说这位基督教经纪人向中国国王介绍了一位刚沐浴过的年轻人。当我见到他时，我问他是否要拿回自己的钱。他让我先等等，等到卖完庄稼后再来取钱，并承诺下周再来。

paragraphs.en: After he left, I thought it best to invite him for a meal next time.
paragraphs.zh: 他走后，我觉得下次最好请他共进晚餐。

paragraphs.en: He was absent for the rest of the year, during which I used his money to trade and made significant profits. At the end of the year, he returned wearing fine clothes. I invited him to dine as my guest, swearing by the New Testament that he must eat with me.
paragraphs.zh: 他整个一年都没有回来，期间我用他的钱进行交易，赚取了丰厚的利润。年末时，他穿着体面的衣服回来了。我邀请他共进晚餐，并举起新约圣经发誓一定要与我同桌而食。

paragraphs.en: He agreed on condition that any expenses would come from his own funds. I prepared a sumptuous meal, including beverages, stuffed chickens, and sweets, which I placed before him. He ate with his left hand, prompting me to think, "Only God is perfect; this young man, though handsome and respectable, is so arrogant he does not use his right hand."
paragraphs.zh: 他同意了，但条件是他所有的开销都由他自己承担。我准备了一顿丰盛的饭菜，包括饮料、填馅鸡和甜点，摆在了他的面前。他用左手进食，我不禁心想：“上帝才是完美的；这位年轻人虽然英俊且体面，却如此傲慢，连右手都不愿使用。”

paragraphs.en: Morning came, and Shahrazad fell silent. Dinarzad remarked, "What a strange and entertaining story!" Shahrazad replied, "This pales in comparison to what I will tell you tomorrow night if the king spares me."
paragraphs.zh: 晨光初现，沙赫拉兹沉默下来。丁纳扎德remarked道：“这真是个奇怪而有趣的故事！”沙赫拉兹 aden应道：“比起我明天晚上要讲的，这简直不值一提，如果国王饶恕我的话。”

paragraphs.en: The following night, Shahrazad began:
paragraphs.zh: 当晚，舍赫拉查德开口说道：

paragraphs.en: O happy King, when we finished eating, I poured water on his hand and gave him something to wipe it with. After offering him some sweets, we sat to chat. I asked, "Sir, why did you eat with your left hand?
paragraphs.zh: 贤明的君王，当我们吃完饭后，我为他洗手，并给了他毛巾擦干。随后，我递给他一些糖果，请他品尝。我们便坐下来闲聊。我问道：“阁下，您为何用左手进食呢？”

paragraphs.en: Is there something wrong with your right hand?" The young man wept as he recited:
paragraphs.zh: “你的右手出了什么问题吗？”年轻人边哭边念道：

paragraphs.en: If Leyla for Selma I have exchanged, 'Twas not at will but by necessity.
paragraphs.zh: 如果我用莱拉换塞玛，那并非出于自愿，而是迫于无奈。

paragraphs.en: He then revealed his right arm, which was a stump with the hand cut off at the wrist. Astonished, I asked, "Do you think this makes you conceited? Why did your hand get cut off?"
paragraphs.zh: 他随即露出了右臂，只见肘部以上只剩下一段残肢，手掌在腕关节处被截断了。我惊讶地问道：“你认为这样会让你自以为是吗？你的手是怎么被截掉的？”

paragraphs.en: He sighed and wept, explaining how it happened.
paragraphs.zh: 他叹了口气，流下了眼泪，解释起事情的经过。

paragraphs.en: I was a native of Baghdad and son to one of its most prominent men. Upon reaching adulthood, I became fascinated with Egypt after hearing tales from travelers. After my father's death, inheriting his business, I prepared a caravan load of goods, including fabrics from Baghdad and Mosul, and set off for Egypt.
paragraphs.zh: 我出生在巴格达，是当地一位显赫人物的儿子。成年后，听闻旅行者讲述埃及的故事，便对那里产生了浓厚的兴趣。在我父亲去世后，继承了他的生意，我准备了一辆商队，装载着来自巴格达和摩苏尔的布匹，踏上了前往埃及的旅程。

paragraphs.en: Upon arriving in Cairo, I unloaded at the Masrur Caravansary, unpacked the merchandise, and stored it safely. Then, sending one servant to buy food, I rested before walking along Bain al-Qasrain Street. Returning to my lodging, I opened the fabric bales and decided to visit a market.
paragraphs.zh: 抵达开罗后，我在马苏鲁旅店卸下货物，整理好商品并妥善存放。随后，派一名仆人去买食物，自己则先休息片刻，随后沿着巴因·阿勒·卡斯雷恩街漫步。返回住处后，我打开布匹包裹，决定去市场转转。

paragraphs.en: I went to Jerjes Market, where brokers greeted me, having heard of my arrival. They auctioned my fabrics but failed to sell them for their cost. Disappointed, I complained to the brokers about the poor prices.
paragraphs.zh: 我来到了杰尔jes市场，那些经纪人听说我到了，纷纷前来迎接。他们拍卖了我的布料，但最终却未能以成本价售出。失望之余，我对那些经纪人大发牢骚，抱怨价格太低。

paragraphs.en: The next night, Shahrazad continued her tale: "O happy King, I heard that the Christian broker told the king of China that the young man said..."
paragraphs.zh: 第二天晚上，沙 Hessar 纳德继续讲述她的故事：“哦，幸福的国王，我听说那位基督教经纪人向中国国王转述说……”

paragraphs.en: The brokers advised me to sell goods on credit with a written contract, using a money changer. This way, I could enjoy Cairo's sights while making profits. Following their advice, I sold bales of fabric in the market under a witnessed contract, leaving it with the banker.
paragraphs.zh: 经纪人们建议我采用书面合同赊账销售货物，并通过钱庄进行交易，这样既能欣赏开罗的风光，又能赚取利润。按照他们的建议，在见证人的监督下，我在市场上卖出了几批布匹，并将货款交给了银行家。

paragraphs.en: For a month, I enjoyed my mornings with wine, mutton, pigeons, and sweets at the caravansary. Then, as receipts became due, I began visiting the market every Monday and Thursday. Sitting in merchants' shops, I waited while scribes and money changers collected payments until after afternoon prayers.
paragraphs.zh: 在一个多月里，我每天早上都在客店享用美酒、羊肉、鸽子和甜点。但随着账单到期，我开始每周一四去市场。坐在商人的店铺里，我等着文员和兑换商收齐款项，直到午后祷告之后。

paragraphs.en: They returned with the money, which I counted and acknowledged before returning to the caravansary.
paragraphs.zh: 他们带着钱回来了，我清点完毕后便回到客店里。

paragraphs.en: I continued my task for six days. One Monday morning, I went to the bath early and returned to the caravansary. After breakfasting on wine, I slept until noon.
paragraphs.zh: 我连续工作了六天。一个周一的早晨，我早早去洗了个澡，然后回到了客店。吃完用葡萄酒充饥的早餐后，我睡到了中午。

paragraphs.en: Upon waking, I ate a boiled chicken, perfumed myself, and headed to the market where I sat at Badr al-Din al-Bustani's shop.
paragraphs.zh: 醒来后，我吃了一只炖鸡，精心打扮了一番，便前往市场，在巴德尔·阿丁·阿尔·布斯坦尼的店铺里坐了下来。

paragraphs.en: A lady entered, wearing a cloak and magnificent headcloth, her beauty captivating me. She revealed large black eyes when she raised her veil, greeted Badr al-Din, and asked if he had silk with hunting scenes. He showed her one of my pieces, which she bought for 1,200 dirhams.
paragraphs.zh: 一位女士走了进来，身穿斗篷和华丽的头巾，她的美貌让我为之倾倒。她掀起面纱露出一双深邃的黑眼睛，向巴德尔丁问好，并询问他是否有描绘狩猎场景的丝绸。巴德尔丁拿给她一件我的作品，她以一千二百第纳尔的价格买下了它。

paragraphs.en: She proposed taking the fabric and sending payment later but was rebuffed by Badr al-Din. She accused him of disrespecting customers, threw the fabric back, and left angrily.
paragraphs.zh: 她提议先拿走布料，稍后再付款，但被巴德尔丁拒绝了。她指责他怠慢顾客，把布料扔回去，气愤地离开了。

paragraphs.en: Shahrazad then fell silent as morning approached. Dinarzad remarked, "Sister, what a strange and engaging tale!" Shahrazad replied, "Wait until tomorrow night; I have an even more captivating story if the king spares me."
paragraphs.zh: 莎赫拉兹随后沉默下来，晨光渐渐临近。丁纳扎德remarked道，“姐姐，这真是个奇怪而引人入胜的故事！”莎赫拉兹回答说，“等到明天晚上吧；如果国王饶恕我，我还有一篇更加扣人心弦的故事要讲。”

paragraphs.en: The next night, Shahrazad began: O King, I heard that the Christian broker told the king of China about the young man's words.
paragraphs.zh: 第二天晚上，沙赫拉兹阿德开口说道：“国王陛下，我听说那位基督教商人向中国的国王转述了那个年轻人的话。”

paragraphs.en: When she returned the fabric to the shop and started to leave, I pleaded with her, "Lady, please come back for a moment." She turned around, smiling, and sat facing me. I asked Badr al-Din, "What was the price we agreed on?"
paragraphs.zh: 当她把布料还给店铺并准备离开时，我恳求她说：“夫人，请您留步片刻。”她转过身来，面带微笑地坐下，面对着我。我对巴德兰丁问道，“我们之前商量好的价格是多少？”

paragraphs.en: He replied, "One thousand two hundred dirhams." I said, "I'll give you one hundred as profit. Give me a piece of paper to write a discharge."
paragraphs.zh: 他回答说：“一千二百第纳尔。”我说：“我给你一百作为利润，给我一张纸写一份免责文书。”

paragraphs.en: I wrote him the discharge, took the fabric, and gave it to her. "Take this," I said, "and if you wish, bring the money next market day or consider it a gift from me."
paragraphs.zh: 我给他写了结账单，收好布料后交给了她。“拿着这个，”我说，“如果愿意的话，你可以下次集市日带来货款，否则就当我送你的礼物吧。”

paragraphs.en: She thanked me warmly, saying, "May God reward you with more wealth and longer life than mine." Then she left, while I stayed in the shop until after the afternoon prayer, lost in thought. When I asked Badr al-Din about her, he said she was a wealthy lady, daughter of a deceased prince who had left her a great fortune.
paragraphs.zh: 她热情地向我道谢，说：“愿上帝赐予你比我更多的财富和更长的寿命。”说完便离开了。而我则留在店里直到午后祷告之后，陷入了沉思。当我问及巴德尔丁关于她的事时，他告诉我她是位富有的女士，是已故王子的女儿，继承了一笔巨额财产。

paragraphs.en: That night, Shahrazad fell silent. Dinarzad remarked, "Sister, what an intriguing tale!" Shahrazad replied, "Wait until tomorrow night if the king spares me."
paragraphs.zh: 那天晚上，沙赫拉兹沉默不语。丁纳札德remarked道，“姐姐，这故事真引人入胜！”沙赫拉兹答道，“如果国王饶恕我，我们明天夜晚再听下去吧。”

paragraphs.en: The next night, Shahrazad began:
paragraphs.zh: 第二天晚上，舍赫拉查德开口说道：

paragraphs.en: O happy King, I heard that the Christian broker told the king of China about a young man who had lost his hand.
paragraphs.zh: 幸亏的国王，我听说那位基督经纪人向中国国王讲述了一个失去一只手的年轻人的故事。

paragraphs.en: Upon entering Badr al-Din's shop, a lady arrived, more elegantly dressed than before. She greeted me instead of the merchant and asked for money to be received. When I inquired about the urgency, she replied with a heartfelt plea, handing over the money.
paragraphs.zh: 走进巴德·阿丁的店铺，来了一位女士，打扮比之前更加优雅。她没有向商人问候，而是转向我，请求收下一些钱。当我问及原因时，她语气恳切地回答，并递上了钱。

paragraphs.en: We conversed briefly, and she left hastily, leaving my heart behind.
paragraphs.zh: 我们简单交谈了几句，她便匆匆离去，留下我心中一片茫然。

paragraphs.en: In the market, a black maid approached, informing me that the lady wished to speak with me. Surprised, I followed her to the lane of moneychangers. The lady drew me aside, confessing that since our first meeting, she had lost her appetite for food and drink.
paragraphs.zh: 在市场上，一个黑皮肤的女仆走过来告诉我，那位女士想和我谈谈。我颇感意外，跟着她来到了钱庄巷。那位女士把我拉到一旁，坦白说自从我们初次见面后，她的饮食都失去了兴趣。

paragraphs.en: I admitted feeling similarly but noted my lack of permanent lodging.
paragraphs.zh: 我也有同感，不过提到这里时，我顺便提了一句自己还没有固定的住处。

paragraphs.en: That night, Shahrazad paused, and Dinarzad remarked on the story's intrigue. Shahrazad promised to tell an even more captivating tale if the king spared her life.
paragraphs.zh: 那天晚上，沙赫拉扎德停了下来，丁达尔赞对这个故事的悬念表示赞赏。沙赫拉扎德承诺如果国王饶恕她一命，她会讲述一个更加引人入胜的故事。

paragraphs.en: The next night, Shahrazad continued:
paragraphs.zh: 第二天晚上，沙海拉扎德接着说：

paragraphs.en: O King, the Christian broker told the young man: "I have no place but the caravansary. Please come to my house." The lady replied, "Tonight is Friday; nothing can be done.
paragraphs.zh: 国王啊，基督徒经纪人对年轻人说：“我只有旅店可去。请到我家来吧。”女士回答道：“今天是星期五，没有什么事情可以办成的。”

paragraphs.en: Tomorrow after your morning prayer, ride an ass to Barqut abu-Shamah's house in Habbaniya and do not delay." The young man agreed and left.
paragraphs.zh: “明天早上祈祷之后，骑一头驴去哈巴尼耶的巴库特·阿布·夏玛家，不要耽搁。”年轻人答应了一声便离开了。

paragraphs.en: I waited for dawn and, once it came, dressed and prepared myself. With fifty dinars in a handkerchief, I left the Masrur Caravansary and hired an ass to take me to Habbaniya. The driver led me to al-Taqwa Lane and directed me to Barqut's house, known as Abu-Shamah.
paragraphs.zh: 我等待黎明，天一亮便起身准备。揣着五十第纳尔，我离开了马苏鲁商队客栈，雇了一头驴前往哈巴尼耶。车夫领我到了塔瓦卡巷，并将我带到了巴库特的住所，也就是阿布-夏玛赫的房子。

paragraphs.en: After giving him a quarter-dinar, I thanked him.
paragraphs.zh: 给了他一枚四分迪那后，我向他表示了感谢。

paragraphs.en: I knocked on the gate, and two white maids invited me inside because their mistress was so pleased with me that she could not sleep. We entered a hall raised seven steps above ground, surrounded by windows overlooking a beautiful garden with running streams and various fruits and birds. At the center stood a square fountain with red gold snakes spouting water.
paragraphs.zh: 我敲了敲门，两位白皙的女仆见主人对我如此满意以至于无法入眠，便邀请我进入。我们走进一间高出地面七级台阶的大厅，四周是窗户，俯瞰着一个美丽花园，园中流水潺潺，各种水果和鸟儿点缀其间。正中央是一座方形喷泉，红金相间的蛇形雕塑从喷泉中吐出水柱。

paragraphs.en: That night, Shahrazad fell silent as morning approached. Dinarzad remarked, "What an intriguing tale!" Shahrazad responded, "Wait until tomorrow night to hear more if I live."
paragraphs.zh: 那天晚上，随着黎明临近，沙赫拉兹沉默不语。丁纳扎德remarked道：“真是个引人入胜的故事！”沙赫拉兹回答说：“等我活着的时候，明天晚上你就会听到更多。”

paragraphs.en: Upon entering the hall, I found a lady adorned in fine clothes and jewelry, her head crowned with a diadem. Her makeup was evident, and her eyes were delicately penciled. As she approached, she smiled warmly, embraced me tightly, and kissed my tongue, which I reciprocated.
paragraphs.zh: 一踏入大厅，我便见到一位身着华服、佩戴珠宝的女士，头上戴着王冠。她的妆容精致，眼线描得恰到好处。她走近时面带温暖的笑容，紧紧地拥抱了我，并亲吻了我的舌头，我也回以一吻。

paragraphs.en: She exclaimed, "Is it true, my lord, that you have come to me?" I replied, "Yes, I am here, your slave." She confessed, "Since our first meeting, I have not enjoyed food or sleep."
paragraphs.zh: 她脱口而出：“我的 Lord，您真的来找我了吗？”我回答道：“是的，我就在这里，您的仆人。”她承认说：“自从我们第一次见面以来，我就再没有享受过美食和睡眠。”

paragraphs.en: I agreed, feeling the same. We sat down to talk, and she offered a tray with sumptuous dishes—ragouts, fricassees, honey-soaked fritters, sugar-stuffed chickens, and pistachio nuts. We ate until satisfied, then servants removed the tray, and we washed our hands in rosewater scented with musk before continuing to converse.
paragraphs.zh: 我赞同，感觉也是如此。我们坐下来交谈，她端上了一大盘丰盛的食物——有炖菜、烩菜、蜂蜜浸油炸糕、糖馅鸡和开心果。我们吃得很满足，仆人们撤走了托盘，然后我们在茉莉香水中浸泡的玫瑰水里洗净双手，继续聊天。

paragraphs.en: My love for her grew, making my wealth seem insignificant compared to her presence. We spent the evening in dalliance until nightfall, when a banquet of food and wine was served. We drank until midnight, then retired to bed where I lay with her all night, feeling it was the best night ever.
paragraphs.zh: 我对她的爱意日益加深，觉得与她在一起的时光远比我的财富更加宝贵。我们整晚沉浸在欢愉之中，直到夜幕降临。宴席上美食佳酿齐备，我们畅饮至深夜十二点，随后便同榻而眠，整夜与她相伴，那一刻我觉得自己度过了有生以来最美好的夜晚。

paragraphs.en: The next morning, I arose, placed the handkerchief containing fifty dinars under the mattress, and left. She wept and asked, "My lord, when shall I see you again?" I promised, "I will be with you this evening."
paragraphs.zh: 第二天一早，我起身，将装有五十第纳尔的手帕放在床垫下，然后离开了。她流着泪问道：“我的主人，我们何时才能再见面？”我承诺道：“今晚我就来陪你。”

paragraphs.en: As she saw me to the door, she requested, "Bring our supper with you."
paragraphs.zh: 她送我到门口时请求道：“你把我们的晚饭一起带上来吧。”

paragraphs.en: When I returned, I found my driver waiting. After a light breakfast, I went to collect money from selling my goods and ordered roasted lamb with rice and sweets. I sent these to the lady's house along with instructions for a porter.
paragraphs.zh: 我回来后发现司机已经在等候。吃过简单的早餐，我去处理货物的销售款项，并吩咐买些烤羊肉和甜食。我把这些一并送到了那位女士的府上，并附上了搬运工的指示。

paragraphs.en: Occupied with business until sunset, I paid the driver half a dinar when he came to fetch me. Upon reaching her house, we feasted, drank wine into midnight, and spent the night together.
paragraphs.zh: 忙于生意直到日落，我付给司机半个第纳尔请他来接我。到了她家后，我们设宴畅饮，直至深夜，当晚便同住了。

paragraphs.en: The next morning, I left fifty dinars with her and returned to the caravansary. Later, I bought geese, colocassia roots in honey, fruits, nuts, herbs, and candles from a delicatessen, sending them all to her house. At sunset, I repeated the journey, spending another night with her before returning to the Masrur Caravansary.
paragraphs.zh: 第二天一早，我留下五十第纳尔给她，然后返回了客店。随后，我在一家食品杂货店买了鹅、蜂蜜ocola根、水果、坚果、草药和蜡烛，全都送到了她的住处。日落时分，我又重复了一遍这段旅程，在她那里过了一夜后，才回到马苏鲁客店。

paragraphs.en: Morning came, and Shahrazad fell silent. Dinarzad remarked, "What an intriguing tale!" Shahrazad replied, "Wait until tomorrow night; this is nothing compared to what I will tell you then."
paragraphs.zh: 晨光初现，沙赫拉兹阿德沉默下来。丁纳札德remarked道：“这故事真引人入胜！”沙赫拉兹阿德回答说：“等到明天晚上再听吧；那时候我要给你讲的故事可比这个精彩多了。”

paragraphs.en: I continued eating and drinking, giving her fifty dinars each night until I ran out of money. Desperate for cash, I left the caravansary and walked to Bain al-Qasran Street near Zuwayla Gate. The crowd was so thick that I pressed against a soldier, my hand landing on his breast pocket.
paragraphs.zh: 我继续吃饭喝酒，每天晚上给她五十第纳尔，直到钱花光了。为了筹措资金，我离开了客店，走到朱瓦拉门附近的拜因·阿克萨兰街。人群如此密集，我挤到了一个士兵身边，手不自觉地碰上了他的胸兜。

paragraphs.en: Inside, I felt a green tassel attached to a purse. Just then, a camel jostled the soldier, causing him to turn away. Temptation overcame me; I pulled the tassel and drew out a small blue silk purse with coins inside.
paragraphs.zh: 我心中一动，感觉像是有一个绿色流苏系在钱袋上。就在这时，一只骆驼挤了下士兵，让他转开了身。诱惑油然而生，我伸手拉住了那根流苏，抽出一个装着铜币的小蓝绸钱袋。

paragraphs.en: The soldier noticed something missing from his pocket and, upon touching it, found it empty. He turned on me, raising his mace and striking me on the head. People gathered around us, some defending me while others accused me of theft.
paragraphs.zh: 士兵摸了摸口袋，发现少了什么东西，顿时勃然大怒，举起战锤朝我头上砸去。周围的人纷纷围拢过来，有人为我辩护，也有人指控我是小偷。

paragraphs.en: The police chief, captain, and watchmen arrived at the gate and asked what was happening. The soldier claimed I had stolen a blue silk purse containing twenty dinars from his pocket.
paragraphs.zh: 警察局长、副队长和巡警来到门口，询问发生了什么事。士兵指控我从他的口袋里偷走了一个装有二十第纳尔的蓝色丝质钱袋。

paragraphs.en: The chief ordered me to be stripped naked, revealing the purse hidden in my clothes. I fainted as they examined me. When the chief saw the purse, he confirmed my guilt and ordered me taken away.
paragraphs.zh: 首席命令我脱去衣服，露出了藏在衣内的皮囊。检查过程中我晕了过去。见到了那个皮囊，首席确认了我的罪行，并下令将我带走。

paragraphs.en: The next night, Shahrazad began her tale:
paragraphs.zh: 第二天晚上，沙赫拉兹德开始了她的讲述：

paragraphs.en: O happy King, I heard that the Christian broker told the king of China about a young man who was accused of stealing a purse. The chief examined the purse and found twenty dinars inside. He demanded to know if the young man had stolen it.
paragraphs.zh: 贤明的国王，我听说那位基督教经纪人向中国国王讲述了这样一个故事：有人指控一个年轻人偷了一个钱包。首席官员检查了那个钱包，发现里面装有二十第纳尔。他质问那名年轻人是否真的偷了这个钱包。

paragraphs.en: The youth admitted guilt but pleaded for mercy, as he knew confessing would lead to punishment. The chief summoned witnesses, who confirmed his confession. At the Zuwayla Gate, the executioner cut off the young man's right hand.
paragraphs.zh: 青年承认了罪行，但恳求宽恕，因为他知道认罪会导致惩罚。首席官员召集了证人，证实了他的供词。在祖瓦拉城门处，刽子手割下了年轻人的右手。

paragraphs.en: However, due to public sympathy and the soldier’s intervention, the chief spared him from further punishment.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，由于公众的同情以及士兵的干预，首领并未对他施加更严厉的惩罚。

paragraphs.en: The people gave the youth a cup of wine, while the soldier returned the purse, saying it was inappropriate for such a young man to be a thief.
paragraphs.zh: 人们给年轻人倒了一杯酒，而士兵则退还了钱袋，说道：“像你这样的年轻人本不该去做贼。”

paragraphs.en: I wrapped my hand in a rag and hid it inside my shirt. Upon reaching my mistress's house, I collapsed onto her bed. Pale from blood loss, she asked, "My darling, what is wrong?"
paragraphs.zh: 我用一块破布包住手，藏在衣袖里。到了夫人的府上，我一头栽倒在床上。因失血过多而面色苍白，她关切地问道：“心肝儿，你怎么了？”

paragraphs.en: I lied, saying, "I have a headache." Concerned, she urged me to sit up and tell her about the day's events. When I wept without speaking, she continued to question me until nightfall.
paragraphs.zh: 我撒了个谎，说：“我头疼。”她关切地让我坐起来，询问起当天发生的事情。当我默默流泪时，她继续追问，直到夜幕降临。

paragraphs.en: She brought food but I refused it, fearing she would notice my left-handed eating. Finally, she offered wine, insisting I drink it to help reveal what troubled me.
paragraphs.zh: 她端来了食物，但我拒绝了，生怕她会注意到我用左手吃饭。最后，她坚持给我倒了一杯酒，催促我喝下去，说是这样能帮助她看出我心里的烦恼所在。

paragraphs.en: Morning came, and Shahrazad fell silent. Dinarzad remarked, "Sister, that was a strange and captivating story!" Shahrazad replied, "Wait until tomorrow night if the king spares me."
paragraphs.zh: 晨光初现，沙赫拉兹默不作声。丁纳札德说道：“姐姐，那真是一个奇异而引人入胜的故事！”沙赫拉兹adaptably回应道，“如果国王饶恕我，我们明天晚上再听下去吧。”

paragraphs.en: On the hundred and tenth night, I heard the Christian broker tell the king of China: When she offered me wine, I took it with my left hand, tears in my eyes. She cried out, asking why I wept and held the cup that way. I lied about a boil on my right hand but she insisted, forcing me to drink until I fell asleep.
paragraphs.zh: 第一百零一夜，我听那位基督教经纪人向中国国王讲述：当她递给我酒时，我用左手接过，眼中含着泪水。她惊叫起来，问我为何哭泣，并且问我为什么要那样拿着杯子。我谎称右手长了痈肿，但她坚持不放，逼得我喝下了酒，最终醉倒睡去。

paragraphs.en: Upon waking, she examined my right arm and found only a wrist without a hand. Searching me, she discovered the purse and my severed hand wrapped in a handkerchief. She grieved for me through the night.
paragraphs.zh: 她醒来后检查了我的右臂，发现只剩下手腕而没有手掌。她在身上搜查了一番，发现了钱包以及用手帕包裹着的那截断手。整夜她为我难过不已。

paragraphs.en: When I awoke, she had prepared a broth from five chickens for me. After eating and drinking wine, I was about to leave when she asked where I was going. She claimed my love had depleted all my resources, even my hand.
paragraphs.zh: 当我醒来时，她已经为我准备了一锅五只鸡炖的汤。吃完喝完酒后，正要离开，她问我打算去哪里。她说我的爱已耗尽了我所有的财力，甚至包括我的手。

paragraphs.en: She vowed to die at my feet and drew up a marriage contract stating everything belonged to me. She then sent witnesses, paid them, and urged me to take back the money in handkerchiefs from the chest. Overwhelmed with joy, I locked it away, feeling happy.
paragraphs.zh: 她发誓要在我脚边死去，并起草了一份婚约，声明所有财产归我所有。随后，她派人作证、付了钱，并催促我把手帕里的钱财取出来收好。我欣喜若狂地将这些钱锁了起来，心中感到十分愉快。

paragraphs.en: We lived together for less than a month, but she soon fell ill due to grief. Within fifty days, she passed away. After burying her, I found numerous bequests, including a storeroom and sesame crop sold by me.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在一起不到一个月，但她很快就因悲痛而病倒。五十天后，她便去世了。安葬完她之后，我发现她留给我不少遗产，包括一间仓库和一批芝麻。

paragraphs.en: Morning came, and Shahrazad paused. Dinarzad remarked, "Sister, what an intriguing tale!" Shahrazad replied, "This is nothing compared to the story I will tell tomorrow if the king spares me."
paragraphs.zh: 晨光初现，沙赫拉兹阿德停下了讲述。迪纳尔扎德remarked道：“姐姐，这个故事真引人入胜！”沙赫拉兹阿德回答说：“比起我明天可能会讲的故事，这简直不算什么。”

paragraphs.en: The Christian broker explained, "I was too busy selling the remaining goods to attend to you and collect my payment. Now that I've sold everything, I must eat with my left hand as a sign of respect." He continued, "Christian, do not object; I have entered your home and eaten your food.
paragraphs.zh: 基督教经纪人解释说：“我忙于出售剩余的商品，无暇顾及你并收取应得的报酬。现在所有东西都卖完了，我只能用左手吃饭以示尊重。”他继续说道：“克里斯蒂安，不要反对；我已经踏入你的家门，享用了你们的食物。”

paragraphs.en: Here is all the money from the sesame sale—it's only a portion of what God has given me."
paragraphs.zh: 这是芝麻交易所得的所有钱款——这只是上帝赐予我的一部分。

paragraphs.en: The young man then said, "I've prepared merchandise for trade—will you join me?" The narrator agreed to travel with him at the beginning of the month. They bought goods together and set out until they reached the king’s city, where the young man traded and returned to Egypt.
paragraphs.zh: 年轻人接着说：“我已经准备了一些货物打算交易，你愿意和我一起去吗？”叙述者答应在月初与他同行。他们一起购买了货物，出发前往国王的城市，在那里年轻人进行了交易后返回了埃及。

paragraphs.en: The narrator stayed behind.
paragraphs.zh: 叙述者留在了原地。

paragraphs.en: "This is my story," he concluded, "more extraordinary than any tale."
paragraphs.zh: “这就是我的故事，”他总结道，“比任何传奇都要更加离奇。”

paragraphs.en: The Chinese king replied, "No, it's not more amazing than the hunchback's story; you will all be executed for his death."
paragraphs.zh: 中国国王回答说：“不，这并不比驼背的故事更令人惊叹；你们都将为他的死负责。”

paragraphs.en: Then a kitchen steward approached, offering to tell a story if it surpassed the hunchback’s. The king agreed, and the steward began:
paragraphs.zh: 随后，一名厨房主管走了过来，提出如果他的故事胜过驼背人的故事，他就愿意讲一个。国王同意了，于是那主管开口说道：
